message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through the closet, pulling out our go-bags to check on supplies. As I laid everything out on the floor, my grandkids wandered in, curious about the mess. Instead of a chore, we turned it into a cozy little event — we spread out a blanket, sorted through snacks, and even added a few fun items like coloring books. It reminded me that being prepared doesn’t have to feel serious; sometimes, it can be a chance for a little family bonding. Have you ever turned a task into an unexpected adventure?
